fcs_function.name: trackLatOffset
fcs_function.description: distance right of the base course line less the commanded offset, ft

fcs_function.name: latOffset
fcs_function.description: lateralDeviation: the circumnavigator's when guidance is on, else the course offset's when tracking, else the input

fcs_function.name: baseChiCmd
fcs_function.description: trueBaseCourseCommand: the circumnavigator's when guidance is on

fcs_function.name: chiErrUnwrapped
fcs_function.description: autopilotTrackError = chiEst - chiCmd, chiEst = beta + psi, chiCmd = deltaChiCmd + baseChiCmd, deg

fcs_function.name: totLongStk
fcs_function.description: totalLongCmd = longStkTrim + longStkSw + longLQRsw, within [-1, 1]; longStk within [-1, 1]

fcs_function.name: totLatStk
fcs_function.description: totalLatCmd = latStkSw + latLQRsw, within [-1, 1]; latStk within [-1, 1]

fcs_function.name: totPedal
fcs_function.description: totalDirCmd = pedalSw + dirLQRsw, within [-1, 1]; pedal within [-1, 1]

fcs_function.name: totThrottle
fcs_function.description: totalThrottle = throttleTrim + throttleSw + throttleLQRsw, within [0, 1]; throttle within [0, 1]

function.name: f16/aero/tvt
function.description: tvt = 2 vt, ft/s, with vt at least 0.1

function.name: aero/force/f16-x
function.description: aeroBodyForceCoefficient_X qbar S: cx = cxt + cq2v cxq

function.name: aero/force/f16-y
function.description: aeroBodyForceCoefficient_Y qbar S: cy = cy0 + b2v (cyp p + cyr r), cy0 = -0.02 beta + 0.021 dail + 0.086 drdr

function.name: aero/force/f16-z
function.description: aeroBodyForceCoefficient_Z qbar S: cz = czt (1 - (beta/rtd)^2) - 0.19 del + cq2v czq, rtd = 180/3.14159265

function.name: aero/moment/f16-roll
function.description: aeroBodyMomentCoefficient_Roll qbar S bspan: cl = clt + dclda dail + dcldr drdr + b2v (clp p + clr r)

function.name: aero/moment/f16-pitch
function.description: aeroBodyMomentCoefficient_Pitch qbar S cbar: cm = cmt + cq2v cmq

function.name: aero/moment/f16-yaw
function.description: aeroBodyMomentCoefficient_Yaw qbar S bspan: cn = cnt + dcnda dail + dcndr drdr + b2v (cnp p + cnr r)
